description.primary:
Transform your relationship with your thoughts through guided journaling and mindful reflection in a beautifully designed, private digital sanctuary.

ALCHM combines trauma-informed design with AI-powered insights to create a safe space for emotional healing and personal growth. Whether you're processing daily experiences or working through deeper challenges, ALCHM provides gentle guidance without replacing professional care.

✨ KEY FEATURES:
• Private journaling with elegant, distraction-free interface
• Guided healing pathways for emotional growth
• Mood tracking with gentle insights and patterns
• 24/7 crisis support resources and professional referrals
• Premium design focused on calm, clarity, and safety
• Trauma-informed AI that provides supportive reflections

🔒 PRIVACY FIRST:
• Your entries stay secure on your device
• No social features, sharing, or public content
• Optional encrypted cloud backup for safety
• Complete data control and deletion options
• Transparent AI processing with opt-out available

🆘 COMPREHENSIVE SAFETY:
• Immediate access to crisis support (988, 911)
• Professional mental health resource directory
• Gentle trigger warnings and content sensitivity
• Crisis detection with caring resource suggestions
• Medical disclaimer compliance for your protection

🎨 DESIGNED FOR HEALING:
Created with trauma-informed design principles and guidance from mental health professionals. Every interaction is designed to support your emotional well-being while maintaining the highest standards of safety and privacy.

IMPORTANT: ALCHM is a journaling and reflection tool, not therapy or medical treatment. For ongoing mental health support, please consult licensed professionals. Crisis support: 988.

reviewNotes.forAppleReview: ALCHM is a trauma-informed journaling application designed for users 17+. We implement comprehensive safety measures including medical disclaimers, crisis resource access, and privacy-first design. All AI features include clear disclaimers that this is not medical treatment. Crisis detection provides resource suggestions but does not replace professional care. Privacy policy includes COPPA compliance and detailed data handling transparency. The app includes accessibility features for VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, and high contrast modes.
